caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair with a curved top rail and rounded ends. The chair features vertical spindles forming the backrest, and both arms curve outward and downward, ending in scrolls. The seat has a slight contour and both the seat and top rail display subtle decorative patterns in gold. The chair's legs and rockers are depicted in perspective, showing the curved wooden rockers attached at the bottom. The overall color of the chair is dark brown or black, with the decorative elements and details in gold. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or designs present. The artist's signature and name, "H. Gramat H. Eisman," are written in small text below the chair to the left.
title: Rocking Chair
